## RgbHelpers.to8Bit() method

Convert to 8-bit channels: each channel is divided by [RGB_8BIT_SCALE](./contracts.rgb_8bit_scale.md) and rounded half away from zero.

**Signature:**

```typescript
to8Bit(rgb: Rgb): Rgb8Bit;
```

## Exceptions

`RangeError` when a channel of `rgb` is not valid.

## Remarks

Lossy: 16-bit channels that are not multiples of 257 do not survive a round trip through 8 bits.
